name: Kanchipuram silk stole
about: A silk weave from Tamil Nadu, known for rich colors and gold borders. A stole is easier to carry home than a full sari.
tip: Choose a stole over a sari if you want something light and easy to pack.

name: Filter coffee
about: South Indian coffee brewed with a metal filter, often mixed with chicory. It is a daily drink across Chennai.
tip: Check the chicory blend on the label before you buy, since the ratio changes the taste.
